description: Fires on user moves that execute a step of a known trap line as the SETTER/PUNISHER side (trap_record.step_label='trap_player_punishes' AND this_move_by_user=true). The trap-setup celebration on the setup-complete move (a4 in the QGA Greedy ...b5 Trap) plants the lesson; this rule keeps the lesson visible on every subsequent punisher move (axb5, Qf3) so the user knows *why* their move was strong — it's part of the named trap they set up. Without this, the punisher moves get a generic R15 capture / R03 threat caption and the per-step teaching authored in traps.json never reaches the screen. Mohit 2026-05-28 (game 65650b2b m6 Qf3).

fact_glossary.trap_step_explanation: Authored explanation for THIS step from trap_line_steps in data/traps.json
fact_glossary.trap_next_expected_move: Next move the trap line expects (empty when this move completes the line)
fact_glossary.trap_step_label: 'trap_player_punishes' when the setter is winning material/position this move; 'victim_falls' when the victim's move is in the trap line (typically forced)
